name: Hirz Mountain Lookout
design: BC-3 cab on a 20 ft steel tower with catwalk
agency: USDA Forest Service, Shasta-Trinity National Forest

access.note: Reached by a narrow, low-speed dirt road recommended for 4WD vehicles; rental only.

visit.trail_note: 5 miles of single-lane dirt road (35N04) with limited sight distance.

rental.pets: Not stated in the current listing
rental.fee: About $100 per night, 4-night maximum per group per year
rules: High-clearance vehicle recommended for the final 5 miles of dirt road
No water, electricity, or cooking facilities in the cab
Vault toilet and picnic table outside only
rental.access_note: Reached by a narrow, low-speed dirt road (FS 35N04) with limited sight distance.
rental.description: A 1937 CCC-built cab raised onto a 20-foot steel tower with a catwalk in 1949, overlooking the McCloud Arm of Shasta Lake. Restored in 2005 and rented through recreation.gov.

events.note: 14x14 BC-3 live-in cab built by the CCC.
Raised onto a new 20 ft steel tower with catwalk.
Restored as a Forest Service Centennial event.
